description: This file defines the ParserException class within the ScssPhp\\ScssPhp\\Exception namespace, representing exceptions related to SCSS parsing errors. It extends the base PHP Exception class and implements the SassException interface, providing methods to get and set the source position of the error.

classes.name: ParserException
classes.description: An exception class representing errors encountered during SCSS parsing, capturing source position details.

methods.name: getSourcePosition
methods.description: Retrieves the source position (file, line, column) where the parsing error occurred.

methods.name: setSourcePosition
methods.description: Sets the source position information indicating where in the source the error was detected.
